entities.summary: Andrei Igorevich Antonov is a Belarusian professional ice hockey defenceman. He currently plays for Yunost Minsk of the Belarusian Extraliga (BXL). He has previously played in the Kontinental Hockey League with HC Dynamo Minsk, Avtomobilist Yekaterinburg and HC Yugra.
